lines: Gaiza and Asagi-sensei had been fighting with unrelenting swiftness, but Gaiza's movements were clearly starting to slow down.
He was out of breath and clearly exhausted.
You're a restless... nimble old hag...
Just give up already and surrender.
On the other hand, Asagi-sensei's breath wasn't the least bit ragged. She looked relaxed and was waiting for the next attack.
She didn't seem to want to kill him. She was just trying to wear him down and make him give up.
However, I thought something seemed strange about Gaiza's behavior.
(Even Gaiza should know that he can't defeat someone like Asagi-sensei in a head-on battle.)
If he had just wanted to die a hero's death, there would have been no need to cause all this chaos and keep the other Taimanin awayー
(This can't be it. There must be something... something more to this... behind the scenes...)
Asagi-sensei also seemed to have noticed something else felt wrong.
What have you done? I can sense a faint miasma coming from you.
Is it a kind of strengthening modification? No, that has to be some kind of demonic potion. Answer me. Who gave it to you?
Ugh... haa... I told you... to stop talking down to me, you old hag!!
Gaiza raised his sword with all his might.
A black miasma started to flow from Gaiza's body as he let out the war cry.
(What is that...!? He's totally different from just before...! Is this the power of the demonic potion Asagi-sensei mentioned!?)
Hebiko, Shikanosuke, get ready! Something powerful is coming...!!
A gigantic, miasma-clad odachi cut straight through the headmistress's office...!
(Not even Asagi-sensei will be able to fully block that...!)
It would have looked that way to anybody. However, the one who stopped moving was actually Gaiza.
After a moment of stillness, cracks started to appear in Gaiza's armor andー
Good grief... You're really giving me a hard time.
In the split second that Gaiza had stopped moving, Asagi-sensei had slashed at his armor repeatedly and completely destroyed it.
Th-This can't be... my "Yaksha's Skull"... ugh...
Blood started to spurt from several wounds on his body and he collapsed straight to the floor of the headmistress's office.
Asagi-sensei, however, didn't spare him a single glance and instead turned to look at the office entrance.
So you were the one who was pulling the strings? Muroi-sensei.
The person standing there was the school physician, Muroi-sensei.
I gave him a potion that strengthens Taima Particles... but he is a human being after all. It looks like his body wasn't able to keep up.
Muroi-sensei smiled softly, unhurriedly stepping toward the bloodstained Gaiza.
You, on the other hand, were wonderful. Yes... such power is wasted on a human, Igawa Asagi♪
A dark, shadowy miasma started to flow from the laughing Muroi-sensei's body.
Muroi-sensei... who the hell are you...!?
